name: Crypt Droid
detailed_description:
Crypt Droid is a sci-fi survival FPS game in which you play as an advanced Mining Unit Machine (MUM). Your task is to descend into alien Crypts to find and extract rare Crystals that are essential for the survival of mankind. With relentless alien threats, dwindling resources, and the fate of your entire civilization hanging in the balance, your skills will be put to the ultimate test.

Key Features:

  • Survive! -  Shoot anything that moves as no friends of yours are inside the Crypt. Destroy overgrown alien fauna, fight hordes of awakened angry demons and sneak past the Eye of the Crypt as the Crypt itself is sentient and will try to guard the sacred Tombs and the rare Crystals. 

  • Build Your Base - While you are indeed alone in your journey, what makes you special is the ability not only to mine Crystals but use the Crystals to build structures anywhere you need them. The buildings cover a lot of functionalities, from helping you better navigate the Crypt to printing new droids that can help you fight off enemies or even mine Crystals for you. 

  • Explore the Crypt - Navigate the enigmatic Crypt and find its secrets. From hidden tunnels, to alien Artifacts, to sacred Tombs. Just beware of who lies there. 

  • Mine. Mine. Mine. - Mining starts off easy, and you’ll be able to do it by yourself for a while, but as you need to match a large quota in order to succeed and get extracted you will soon start building droids to accelerate the mining. The final step is to find large Crystal deposits that can be mined only with heavy Mining Drills. All this while the Crypt tries to annihilate you.

Crypt Droid is an exciting adventure for players wanting to explore and adapt to a very atmospheric but dangerous setting. Explore, build, mine, fight and get out from THE CRYPT!.

short_description: Crypt Droid is an atmospheric, first-person survival shooter with base building elements. Play as an advanced mining robot and descend into alien Crypts to mine rare Crystals while fighting off hordes of angry demons. Build your base, mine Crystals, and shoot anything that moves.
